context: Flag 5v5. Third down with 3 yards to go.

options.reason: You only need 3 yards. Quick outs get the ball out fast, before the rusher arrives, for an easy first down.
Slants are quick too, but the middle is crowded. The sideline is the safer spot for a short gain.
The wheel route takes a long time to open up. The rusher is only 7 yards away, and you only need 3.
